question:
Select the most appropriate synonym for the underlined word in the given sentence.

Wordsworth wished to work on his poems in __solitude__.
solution:
The correct answer is "**seclusion**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• '**Solitude**' means state of being alone, often by choice. (एकान्त)

 
 
• **Example**- She enjoyed the peace and solitude of the cabin.
 
 
 
• '**Seclusion**' means the state of being private and away from other people. (पृथक्करण)
 
 
• **Example**- His seclusion allowed him ample time to meditate.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is similar in meaning to the given word is 'seclusion'.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• '**Security**' means freedom from danger, risk, etc. (सुरक्षा) 
 
• '**Slumber**' means to sleep, especially lightly. (निद्रा) 
 
• '**Satiety**' is the state of being satiated or full. (संतोष)
